name: Kyouhaku Netorare Seiso Tsuma ~Haramase Shussan made Shikyuu ni Sosogare Tsuzuketa Hitozuma~
original_name: 脅迫ネトラレ清楚妻 ～孕ませ出産まで子宮に注がれ続けた人妻～
source:
[url=/c130766]Sakura Rumi[/url] (27)
One day, she heard some intense voices from the couple next door.
Out of curiosity, she peeks through the window.
Her peeking becomes more bold with each day,
and their eyes meet one day.
She leaves in a panic, but..

translation:
[url=/c130766]樱花留美[/url] (27)
有一天，她听到隔壁那对夫妇传来一些激烈的声音。
出于好奇，她透过窗户往外看。
她的偷看行为一天比一天大胆，
有一天他们的目光相遇了。
她惊慌失措地离开了，但是..
